description: Returns ECP (Enterprise Cache Protocol) connection status. Reports whether ECP is configured on this instance and, if so, the connection health. Gracefully returns 'ECP not configured' when ECP is not in use. No parameters required.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_ecp_status
title: ECP Status
